description.value: Beest is a Japanese ramen restaurant in Vancouver's West End specializing in roast beef marinated ramen, a distinctive style that sets it apart from more common tonkotsu or shoyu spots. Located on Bute Street, it offers indoor seating for cyclists looking to refuel with a warming bowl after a ride through the city. The Instagram handle @beest_vancouver suggests an active social presence for checking current offerings.
